edit.name: edit
edit.description: Create, overwrite, or patch a file. Create/overwrite: provide path + content. Patch: provide path + search (exact literal text) + replace. search must match exactly one location including whitespace/indentation. Read the file before patching. Content and replacement whitespace are preserved exactly; supply actual newline characters when needed. JSON escapes are decoded once; literal backslash sequences are preserved, not decoded again. Use only one mode per call.

path.description: File path to create or edit.

content.description: Full file content (create/overwrite mode). Whitespace is preserved exactly, including trailing newlines.

search.description: Exact literal text to find (patch mode). Include surrounding context for unique match.

execute.name: execute
execute.description: Run a shell command in a persistent terminal visible to the user. Commands yield after a short initial wait with partial output, terminalId and executionId; completion resumes you automatically. Inspect progress or cancel with terminal.execution; do not rerun a running command. Every command is bounded by a finite timeout — 1 hour by default; you may raise `timeout` (up to 24 hours), but the guard can never be disabled. Set isBackground: true for an earlier startup snapshot, useful for servers and watchers. By default commands run on the machine that owns this chat's project. Pass nodeId to run on another connected device (for example a Windows PC); use computer.targets to list node ids, and nodeId "gateway" to force execution on the gateway host.

explanation.description: What the command does (shown to user).

isBackground.description: Return after startup output settles. Useful for servers and watchers; finite jobs also yield automatically after yieldTimeMs.

terminalId.description: Reuse a specific terminal by ID.

yieldTimeMs.description: Initial wait in ms: default 10000, maximum 30000. Zero yields immediately. Returns a running execution if not finished.

timeout.description: Execution deadline in ms, separate from yieldTimeMs. Default 1 hour, maximum 24 hours. Expiry stops the execution; 0/negative uses the default.

sandboxMountMode.description: Sandbox mount mode: none, read-only, read-write.

nodeId.description: Run on another connected device by node id (see computer.targets). "gateway" forces the gateway host, which is the default here.

web.name: web
web.description: Search the web or fetch content from URLs. Provide query for search, url/urls for fetching.

mode.description: "search" or "fetch". Inferred from params if omitted.

body.description: Request body for fetch (used with POST/PUT).

read.name: read
read.description: Read a file or list a directory. Returns file content (with optional line range) or directory entries. Truncates at 6000 lines or 50KB, whichever is hit first; call again with startLine/endLine for more.
